title: Folding Seat Cane – Cane and Chair in One
descriptionHtml:
Where the benches are decides your walk

You can manage the distance — but only if there's somewhere to sit halfway. So the route is always the same route, the one with the bench by the pond. And if it's taken, you turn back earlier than planned, or stand resting against a fence until your legs come back.

The bench comes along in your hand

Unfold the three legs and the chair stands wherever you are. The seat is 29 cm wide and the legs spread 30 cm apart, so it stands steadily in gravel and grass and not just on asphalt. Then it folds back into an ordinary cane and you walk on — without having to plan the route around where the council happened to put a bench.

Features

  • You choose where the break happens – three legs that unfold into a chair anywhere
  • Stands steadily in grass and gravel – the legs spread 30 cm apart, not a stick that sinks in
  • The seat is a real seat, not a stick to lean on – 29 cm wide triangle seat
  • Light enough to carry the whole walk – aluminum frame
  • Folded, it's an ordinary cane – 80 cm, with a handle to walk with

Changing your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations. The product photo shows the item as it is.
